d:
A towering armored entity with a helmet featuring glowing, deep amber eyes peering from a dark void. The face is completely obscured by a massive, ornate iron helm. The build is colossal and heavy, encased in blackened steel armor with gold filigree and a large, spiked pauldron on the left shoulder. The ensemble consists of a heavy plate armor set in charcoal grey and burnished gold, carrying a massive iron mace. A tattered, deep crimson cape flows from the shoulders.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
